name: Limrun

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Public remote Xcode builds and streamed simulators with native automation APIs and log/video recording. Website advertises idle vs build-time rates but publishes no numbers on captured page; contact-sales. iOS simulator is not macOS desktop VM equivalence. Android also supported.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Billing model (from the official OpenAPI spec, no prices): subscription plans with monthlyPrice/yearlyPrice/minutePrice and included monthlyMinutes (credit-minutes that refill monthly). Usage is metered in credits on graduated tiers (labels like 'First 50,000' ... '5,000,001 and above'). Some plans have no overage ('overageRate ... absent when the plan has no overage'). Build instances are priced per phase (build, cache, sync, apiWork, idle); otherwise they are billed on wall-clock. Orgs carry concurrencyLimit and maxConcurrencyLimit. Terms: 'Limrun offers usage-based, monthly, and annual subscription plans. The fees, usage rates ... presented at checkout or set forth in an applicable order form will apply.'
Homepage advertises 'Idle/build time pricing' for remote Xcode (idle priced differently from build), with no numbers. /pricing returns 404, and Wayback has no pricing-page captures.

fleet.notes: Current mobile-dev cloud offering uses Book a Demo/contact workflow. Production-scale customer testimonials are not public self-serve quotas. New-account concurrent simulator/Mac limits, verification and turnaround unpublished.
